hooks.command: IN=$(cat); if [ -n "${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}" ] && printf %s "$IN" | python3 "${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}/scripts/reactive_prefilter.py"; then printf %s "$IN" | python3 "${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}/scripts/directive_recall.py"; fi
